templates.description: What do we know about a person, including their birthday, relationship to Adam, contact details, allergies, interests, residences, and organization roles?
templates.sql: SELECT p.id, p.name, p.birthday, p.relationship_to_adam, (SELECT json_group_array(json_object('type', c.type, 'value', c.value, 'is_primary', c.is_primary)) FROM contact_methods c WHERE c.person_id = p.id) AS contacts, (SELECT json_group_array(a.allergen) FROM allergies a WHERE a.person_id = p.id) AS allergies, (SELECT json_group_array(i.interest) FROM interests i WHERE i.person_id = p.id) AS interests, (SELECT json_group_array(pl.name) FROM residences r JOIN places pl ON pl.id = r.place_id WHERE r.person_id = p.id) AS residences, (SELECT json_group_array(json_object('organization', o.name, 'role', m.role, 'status', m.status, 'start_date', m.start_date, 'end_date', m.end_date)) FROM organization_memberships m JOIN organizations o ON o.id = m.organization_id WHERE m.person_id = p.id) AS organization_roles FROM people p WHERE (:person IS NULL OR p.id = :person) ORDER BY p.name

templates.description: Whose birthday is on a given month and day, or what birthdays are recorded?
templates.sql: SELECT p.id, p.name, p.birthday, p.relationship_to_adam FROM people p WHERE p.birthday IS NOT NULL AND (:birthday IS NULL OR p.birthday = :birthday) ORDER BY p.name

templates.description: When and how did Adam interact with a person?
templates.sql: SELECT i.id, p.name AS person, i.type, i.date FROM interactions i JOIN people p ON p.id = i.person_id WHERE (:person IS NULL OR i.person_id = :person) AND (:start IS NULL OR i.date >= :start) AND (:end IS NULL OR i.date <= :end) ORDER BY i.date DESC, i.id DESC

templates.description: Where does a person have a recorded residence?
templates.sql: SELECT r.id, p.name AS person, pl.name AS place FROM residences r JOIN people p ON p.id = r.person_id JOIN places pl ON pl.id = r.place_id WHERE (:person IS NULL OR r.person_id = :person) ORDER BY p.name, pl.name

templates.description: What are the recorded lease addresses, rent, deposit, start date, and landlord?
templates.sql: SELECT l.id, l.property_address, l.start_date, l.rent_amount, l.rent_currency, l.rent_due_day, l.security_deposit_amount, l.security_deposit_currency, p.name AS landlord FROM leases l LEFT JOIN people p ON p.id = l.landlord_person_id WHERE (:landlord IS NULL OR l.landlord_person_id = :landlord) ORDER BY l.start_date DESC

templates.description: What meetings, plans, and events fall in a period, and what is their status?
templates.sql: SELECT e.id, e.activity, e.date, e.start_datetime, e.end_datetime, e.return_date, e.status, pl.name AS place, e.location, cp.name AS companion, e.companions, op.name AS organizer, o.name AS organization, e.travel_mode, e.confirmation_code FROM events e LEFT JOIN places pl ON pl.id = e.place_id LEFT JOIN people cp ON cp.id = e.companion_person_id LEFT JOIN people op ON op.id = e.organizer_person_id LEFT JOIN organizations o ON o.id = e.organization_id WHERE (:start IS NULL OR COALESCE(e.return_date, substr(e.end_datetime, 1, 10), e.date, substr(e.start_datetime, 1, 10)) >= :start) AND (:end IS NULL OR COALESCE(e.date, substr(e.start_datetime, 1, 10)) <= :end) AND ((:status IS NULL AND COALESCE(e.status, '') <> 'cancelled') OR e.status = :status) AND (:organization IS NULL OR e.organization_id = :organization) ORDER BY COALESCE(e.start_datetime, e.date) ASC, e.id

templates.description: What travel or trips are planned or recorded in a period, including return dates, companions, and booking codes?
templates.sql: SELECT e.id, e.activity, e.date AS departure_date, e.start_datetime, e.end_datetime, e.return_date, e.travel_mode, e.location, pl.name AS place, cp.name AS companion, e.companions, e.confirmation_code, e.status FROM events e LEFT JOIN places pl ON pl.id = e.place_id LEFT JOIN people cp ON cp.id = e.companion_person_id WHERE e.travel_mode IS NOT NULL AND (:start IS NULL OR COALESCE(e.return_date, substr(e.end_datetime, 1, 10), e.date) >= :start) AND (:end IS NULL OR COALESCE(e.date, substr(e.start_datetime, 1, 10)) <= :end) AND ((:status IS NULL AND COALESCE(e.status, '') <> 'cancelled') OR e.status = :status) ORDER BY COALESCE(e.start_datetime, e.date), e.id

templates.description: How many recorded events of each activity occurred in a period?
templates.sql: SELECT e.activity, e.status, COUNT(*) AS event_count, MIN(e.date) AS first_date, MAX(e.date) AS latest_date FROM events e WHERE (:start IS NULL OR e.date >= :start) AND (:end IS NULL OR e.date <= :end) AND ((:status IS NULL AND COALESCE(e.status, '') <> 'cancelled') OR e.status = :status) GROUP BY e.activity, e.status ORDER BY event_count DESC, e.activity

templates.description: What funding events are recorded for an organization, including amounts, currency, leads, dates, and status?
templates.sql: SELECT e.id, e.activity, e.date, e.start_datetime, e.amount, e.currency, e.status, o.name AS organization, lo.name AS lead_organization, lp.name AS lead_person, e.location FROM events e LEFT JOIN organizations o ON o.id = e.organization_id LEFT JOIN organizations lo ON lo.id = e.lead_organization_id LEFT JOIN people lp ON lp.id = e.lead_person_id WHERE e.amount IS NOT NULL AND (:organization IS NULL OR e.organization_id = :organization) AND (:start IS NULL OR COALESCE(e.date, substr(e.start_datetime, 1, 10)) >= :start) AND (:end IS NULL OR COALESCE(e.date, substr(e.start_datetime, 1, 10)) <= :end) AND ((:status IS NULL AND COALESCE(e.status, '') <> 'cancelled') OR e.status = :status) ORDER BY e.date DESC, e.id DESC

templates.description: What purchases or payments were made in a period, optionally at a merchant or for an item?
templates.sql: SELECT x.id, x.date, x.merchant, x.item, x.amount, x.currency, x.companion, x.location, x.receipt_datetime, x.payment_card_last_four FROM expenses x WHERE (:start IS NULL OR x.date >= :start) AND (:end IS NULL OR x.date <= :end) AND (:merchant IS NULL OR x.merchant = :merchant) AND (:item IS NULL OR x.item = :item) ORDER BY x.date DESC, x.id DESC

templates.description: How much did Adam spend in a period, optionally at a merchant or on an item?
templates.sql: SELECT x.currency, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, SUM(x.amount) AS total_spent, MIN(x.date) AS first_date, MAX(x.date) AS latest_date FROM expenses x WHERE (:start IS NULL OR x.date >= :start) AND (:end IS NULL OR x.date <= :end) AND (:merchant IS NULL OR x.merchant = :merchant) AND (:item IS NULL OR x.item = :item) GROUP BY x.currency ORDER BY x.currency

templates.description: How much was spent at each merchant in a period?
templates.sql: SELECT x.merchant, x.currency, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, SUM(x.amount) AS total_spent, MIN(x.date) AS first_date, MAX(x.date) AS latest_date FROM expenses x WHERE (:start IS NULL OR x.date >= :start) AND (:end IS NULL OR x.date <= :end) GROUP BY x.merchant, x.currency ORDER BY total_spent DESC, x.merchant

templates.description: How much was spent on each recorded kind of purchase in a period?
templates.sql: SELECT x.item, x.currency, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, SUM(x.amount) AS total_spent, MIN(x.date) AS first_date, MAX(x.date) AS latest_date FROM expenses x WHERE (:start IS NULL OR x.date >= :start) AND (:end IS NULL OR x.date <= :end) GROUP BY x.item, x.currency ORDER BY total_spent DESC, x.item

templates.description: How much was spent on purchases recording each companion in a period?
templates.sql: SELECT x.companion, x.currency, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, SUM(x.amount) AS total_spent, MIN(x.date) AS first_date, MAX(x.date) AS latest_date FROM expenses x WHERE x.companion IS NOT NULL AND (:start IS NULL OR x.date >= :start) AND (:end IS NULL OR x.date <= :end) GROUP BY x.companion, x.currency ORDER BY total_spent DESC, x.companion

templates.description: What workouts did a person do in a period, including distances, times, grades, places, companions, and personal-best flags?
templates.sql: SELECT w.id, p.name AS person, w.date, w.activity, w.distance_km, w.duration_seconds, w.grade, pl.name AS place, cp.name AS companion, w.personal_best FROM workouts w JOIN people p ON p.id = w.person_id LEFT JOIN places pl ON pl.id = w.place_id LEFT JOIN people cp ON cp.id = w.companion_person_id WHERE (:person IS NULL OR w.person_id = :person) AND (:activity IS NULL OR w.activity = :activity) AND (:start IS NULL OR w.date >= :start) AND (:end IS NULL OR w.date <= :end) ORDER BY w.date DESC, w.id DESC

templates.description: How many workouts did a person do in a period, and what were their total distance and recorded duration?
templates.sql: SELECT p.name AS person, w.activity, COUNT(*) AS workout_count, SUM(w.distance_km) AS total_distance_km, SUM(w.duration_seconds) AS total_duration_seconds, MIN(w.duration_seconds) AS shortest_recorded_duration_seconds, MAX(w.distance_km) AS longest_distance_km, SUM(CASE WHEN w.personal_best = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS flagged_personal_bests, MAX(w.date) AS latest_date FROM workouts w JOIN people p ON p.id = w.person_id WHERE (:person IS NULL OR w.person_id = :person) AND (:activity IS NULL OR w.activity = :activity) AND (:start IS NULL OR w.date >= :start) AND (:end IS NULL OR w.date <= :end) GROUP BY w.person_id, p.name, w.activity ORDER BY workout_count DESC, p.name, w.activity

templates.description: Which workouts were explicitly recorded as personal bests in a period?
templates.sql: SELECT w.id, p.name AS person, w.date, w.activity, w.distance_km, w.duration_seconds, w.grade, pl.name AS place, cp.name AS companion, w.personal_best FROM workouts w JOIN people p ON p.id = w.person_id LEFT JOIN places pl ON pl.id = w.place_id LEFT JOIN people cp ON cp.id = w.companion_person_id WHERE w.personal_best = 1 AND (:person IS NULL OR w.person_id = :person) AND (:activity IS NULL OR w.activity = :activity) AND (:start IS NULL OR w.date >= :start) AND (:end IS NULL OR w.date <= :end) ORDER BY w.date DESC, w.id DESC

templates.description: What is a person's latest workout of each activity, or their latest workout of one activity?
templates.sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT w.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY w.person_id, w.activity ORDER BY w.date DESC, w.id DESC) AS rn FROM workouts w WHERE (:person IS NULL OR w.person_id = :person) AND (:activity IS NULL OR w.activity = :activity) AND (:start IS NULL OR w.date >= :start) AND (:end IS NULL OR w.date <= :end)) SELECT w.id, p.name AS person, w.date, w.activity, w.distance_km, w.duration_seconds, w.grade, pl.name AS place, cp.name AS companion, w.personal_best FROM ranked w JOIN people p ON p.id = w.person_id LEFT JOIN places pl ON pl.id = w.place_id LEFT JOIN people cp ON cp.id = w.companion_person_id WHERE w.rn = 1 ORDER BY w.date DESC, p.name

templates.description: What books has Adam recorded, and what are their authors, reading statuses, start dates, and ratings?
templates.sql: SELECT b.id, b.title, b.author, b.status, b.start_date, b.rating FROM books b WHERE (:title IS NULL OR b.title = :title) AND (:author IS NULL OR b.author = :author) AND (:status IS NULL OR b.status = :status) AND (:start IS NULL OR b.start_date >= :start) AND (:end IS NULL OR b.start_date <= :end) ORDER BY b.start_date DESC, b.title

templates.description: What tasks or reminders does a person have, including gift-related tasks, due dates, and completion status?
templates.sql: SELECT t.id, t.title, t.due_date, t.due_month, t.status, p.name AS responsible_person FROM tasks t LEFT JOIN people p ON p.id = t.person_id WHERE (:person IS NULL OR t.person_id = :person) AND ((:status IS NULL AND COALESCE(t.status, '') <> 'done') OR t.status = :status) AND (:start IS NULL OR COALESCE(t.due_date, t.due_month) >= substr(:start, 1, CASE WHEN t.due_date IS NULL THEN 7 ELSE 10 END)) AND (:end IS NULL OR COALESCE(t.due_date, t.due_month) <= substr(:end, 1, CASE WHEN t.due_date IS NULL THEN 7 ELSE 10 END)) ORDER BY COALESCE(t.due_date, t.due_month) IS NULL, COALESCE(t.due_date, t.due_month), t.id

templates.description: Who belongs or belonged to an organization, in what roles, and with what membership status and dates?
templates.sql: SELECT m.id, o.name AS organization, o.type AS organization_type, p.name AS person, m.role, m.start_date, m.end_date, m.status, m.dues_amount, m.dues_currency, m.billing_frequency FROM organization_memberships m JOIN organizations o ON o.id = m.organization_id JOIN people p ON p.id = m.person_id WHERE (:organization IS NULL OR m.organization_id = :organization) AND (:person IS NULL OR m.person_id = :person) AND ((:status IS NULL AND COALESCE(m.status, '') <> 'ended') OR m.status = :status) ORDER BY o.name, p.name, m.id

templates.description: What membership fees are recorded for a person or organization, and how often are they billed?
templates.sql: SELECT m.id, p.name AS person, o.name AS organization, m.role, m.dues_amount, m.dues_currency, m.billing_frequency, m.start_date, m.end_date, m.status FROM organization_memberships m JOIN people p ON p.id = m.person_id JOIN organizations o ON o.id = m.organization_id WHERE m.dues_amount IS NOT NULL AND (:person IS NULL OR m.person_id = :person) AND (:organization IS NULL OR m.organization_id = :organization) AND ((:status IS NULL AND COALESCE(m.status, '') <> 'ended') OR m.status = :status) ORDER BY o.name, p.name

templates.description: What emails were received in a period or from a person or organization, and what did they say?
templates.sql: SELECT e.id, e.sent_datetime, e.from_address, e.to_address, p.name AS sender, o.name AS sender_organization, e.subject, e.body FROM emails e LEFT JOIN people p ON p.id = e.sender_person_id LEFT JOIN organizations o ON o.id = e.sender_organization_id WHERE (:person IS NULL OR e.sender_person_id = :person) AND (:organization IS NULL OR e.sender_organization_id = :organization) AND (:subject IS NULL OR e.subject = :subject) AND (:start IS NULL OR substr(e.sent_datetime, 1, 10) >= :start) AND (:end IS NULL OR substr(e.sent_datetime, 1, 10) <= :end) ORDER BY e.sent_datetime DESC, e.id DESC

templates.description: What foods has a person tried, where, when, and what did they think?
templates.sql: SELECT f.id, p.name AS person, f.food, f.venue, f.experience, f.date FROM food_experiences f JOIN people p ON p.id = f.person_id WHERE (:person IS NULL OR f.person_id = :person) AND (:start IS NULL OR f.date >= :start) AND (:end IS NULL OR f.date <= :end) ORDER BY f.date DESC, f.id DESC
